title: Bike shop tagline only
brief:
Client: Spoke Lantern Repairs; contact robin@example.com.
Design one shop logo lockup with the supplied tagline.
Supply the approved lockup as SVG, PNG and PDF.
Two revision rounds include tagline sizing and spacing adjustments.
Initial presentation is due 22 October; final artwork is due 29 October.
Out of scope: a new shop name, vehicle wraps and uniforms.
message: Hey, don't change the logo, just make the tagline bigger. Everything else in the proof can stay as it is. Cheers!
